sim_ragsr.comments: RAG-SR / EvolutionaryForest 环境；仓库通过 PYTHONPATH=. 暴露，post_install_commands 只安装外部依赖，避免 tpot/xgboost 最新依赖触发源码构建

sim_tpsr.comments: TPSR (Transformer-based Planning for Symbolic Regression)环境
post_install_commands: python -c "from pathlib import Path; import urllib.request; p=Path('scientific_intelligent_modelling/algorithms/e2esr_wrapper/model.pt'); p.parent.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True); p.exists() or urllib.request.urlretrieve('https://dl.fbaipublicfiles.com/symbolicregression/model1.pt', str(p))"
